grip.note: the grip pixel is the left column of the 2 px wound grip, through the middle of the fist; the belly stands one pixel in front of it

note: The Order Archer's bow, 23 px: a short recurve in dark wood, gilt tips and collars, the grip wound in linen; the string to the left (back, toward the archer), drawn to the right hand's place 4 px behind the grip at the full draw.
